messages:
Anna (CS): Kickoff for Neonix Labs onboarding — quick sync to confirm stakeholders, success criteria, timelines, and any renewal risks. Tentative 60d plan attached. Please chime in with owners. @leo @mira @devon
Leo (Eng): Thanks. I'll own infra readiness + dev escrow. Need to confirm model variant and token SLOs. Can someone share expected QPS?
Mira (PM): I'll own success criteria & enablement schedule. High-level goals: 1) canonical prompts + eval harness; 2) <3s p95 for chat; 3) monthly cost < $X (placeholder).
Devon (Onboard): I'll coordinate PM/Eng handoffs and schedule enablement sessions. Proposed cadence: weekly 30m standups first 4 weeks, then biweekly. Is that ok?
Anna (CS): That cadence is fine. Stakeholders from Neonix: their engineering lead will observe enablement. Also need legal + security signoff by day 14 for any Private deploy.
Raj (SRE): On SLOs: p95 <3s depends on batch config. I'll spin up a dedicated pool (small) for pilot. Need model size + expected concurrency. Send QPS numbers.
Leo (Eng): Prototype model: bloom-7b; expecting spikes ~15 QPS, average 4. Will validate with perf harness.
Mira (PM): Success criteria — acceptance tests: 1) prompt set pass rate >= 85% on candidate model; 2) latency SLO met in staging for 72h; 3) no P0 infra incidents in first 14d.
Anna (CS): Renewal risk: Neonix is HIPAA-adjacent and very security-sensitive. Flagged risk: 'security-signoff-delay' — this could push go-live and impact renewal cadence.
Devon (Onboard): Action items (owners): - Anna: confirm Neonix contacts and intro call - Leo: perf harness + staging config - Raj: capacity estimate + dedicated pool - Mira: build eval prompt set - Devon: schedule enablement & create runbook
Anna (CS): I'll DM Neonix to get their security contact and arrange the intro. Also attaching the initial onboarding checklist below.
onboard-bot: Created doc: https://redwood.internal/onboard/NEONIX-123/checklist
Anna (CS): Quick checklist snippet:
```
Day 0-7: credentials, network allowlist, model pin, staging tests
Day 8-14: security & legal signoff, pilot traffic, enablement session 1
Day 15-30: expanded pilot, cost tuning, caching policy
Day 31-60: go-live prep, SLA handover, renewal scorecard
```
Mira (PM): Let's capture feedback loop: weekly prompt fail samples -> Mira + CS review -> if regressions >10% trigger rollback to fallback model.
Leo (Eng): Noted. Will add metrics in Console dashboard and alert threshold.
Anna (CS): OK team — please add any scheduling conflicts by EOD. I'll run the intro call tomorrow 10am PT unless someone objects.
Devon (Onboard): Works for me.
Raj (SRE): I'm good.
Leo (Eng): fine.
Mira (PM): fine.
Anna (CS): Great, I'll send invites. :tada:
